Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.

• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

Our client is an international organisation headquartered in Brussels, bringing together members and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a fast-paced and multicultural environment, the organisation is seeking an Administration Officer to support its administrative, financial and office management activities and help ensure the efficient running of its operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage shared mailboxes and handle day-to-day business correspondence.
• Process invoices and maintain accurate supplier and financial records.

• Coordinate with external finance partners and maintain relevant documentation.
• Oversee recurring fees, contributions and other incoming payments.

• Prepare administrative and financial reports, dashboards and internal tracking files.

• Assist with the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate office facilities, suppliers, equipment and service providers.
• Support employee onboarding and offboarding administration.
• Maintain efficient filing systems and contribute to process improvements.
• Provide broader administrative and operational support as needed.

A successful Project Officer should have:

• Previous experience in administration, operations support, office coordination or a similar role.
• Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
• Able to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of internal and external stakeholders.

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
